ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (estimated 85%) with localized low-intensity black margins (estimated 15%) concentrated at the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A continuous low-intensity black border circumscribes the trailing edge and tips. A central black pigmentation anchor is visible at the median notch. Mid-intensity yellow-tan chromatic patches are concentrated in the lower central quadrants of both lobes. Sparse, low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) are scattered across the high-intensity white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate vertex angle of 95 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/6th of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude pixel deviations (approx. 2-8 pixels) along the continuous boundary, creating a jagged profile most pronounced on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp convex arcs at the outer lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of 4-6 distinct, roughly circular high-intensity pixel groups localized at the distal tip of the right lobe, contrasting against the black pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 3-5 sub-parallel, dark linear pixel chains oriented vertically on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive mid-intensity yellow-brown chromatic variation (diatom film) covering the lower-central region of both lobes; no major structural amputations or trailing edge trauma detected.
other_distinctive_markers: Proninent black pigmentation 'bleed' extending from the median notch into the high-intensity ventral surface of both lobes.
